speaker: Penny
text: Okay, let me get this straight. You move in with this guy, he makes you sign a ridiculous roommate agreement, then he walks into your bedroom while you're doing this Joyce Kim and you still stay. Why not?

speaker: Leonard
text: Actually, I couldn't get too mad at him about Joyce Kim. Well, I was doing some government research at the time, you know, military rocket fuel is kind of secret.

speaker: Penny
text: Wait, what does that have to do with Joyce Kim?

speaker: Leonard
text: As it turns out, she was a North Korean spy. Luckily, Sheldon drove her out before I revealed anything important, which I'm not saying I would have.

speaker: Penny
text: So, that's it? You stay with Sheldon all this time because he kept you from going to federal prison?

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, that's part of it. The other part is what happened with the elevator.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, yeah, I'm wondering about that. You said it was working when you moved in.

speaker: Leonard
text: It was. One night Sheldon came home from work.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, hey Sheldon, this is Howard and Raj. They work at the university too.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What is going on here? Hey, hey. I'll get to you later. What are you sitting on?

speaker: Leonard
text: I can't speak for these guys, but I'm sitting on my tushy.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's a joke.

speaker: Leonard
text: Eh, not a good idea.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Tushy is buttocks, right? You're kidding me, idiots. Explain the couch.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, well, there were some people on the first floor moving out and they sold it to me for a hundred dollars. Howard and Raj helped me bring it up.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But what's wrong with the furniture we have?

speaker: Leonard
text: They're lawn chairs. And there was no place for company.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Did it occur to you that was by design?

speaker: Leonard
text: According to the roommate agreement, I'm entitled to allocate fifty percent of the cubic footage of the common areas.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But you didn't notify me by email, so this is still a breach.

speaker: Leonard
text: I did notify you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, you did, did you?
